verdict.rationale: Fireflies' own marketing says it delivers "customized summaries" after every meeting, so some summary customization exists. Nothing documents custom templates, saved prompts, or per-meeting-type formats such as discovery, 1:1 or standup. AskFred's ad-hoc natural-language questions are a related feature, not saved note templates, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented custom note templates, saved prompts, per-meeting-type template assignment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can shape the notes with custom templates or saved prompts per meeting type (discovery call, 1:1, standup) instead of one generic format

citations.quote: Get detailed notes, action items, and customized summaries instantly after every meeting.
